title: RouteRefused payload
description: The model route the run would take is refused: the submit named a route the daemon's file does not declare, a gateway's alias, an address or a token instead of a route's name, or a route for a run that makes no model call (its runbook runs no bound program and no agent node, and its decider is not a model above A0); or the run's decider is a model above A0, it names no route, and the daemon declares routes and no `route_policy.default`. A delegation is refused the same way for the route it names, and when it names none and the daemon has no `route_policy.default`. The run was not submitted and nothing was written. The reason names the member that was wrong (`model_route`, `model_routes.<role>`) and what was wrong, never the value the client sent; `declared` lists the routes the daemon declares, in order of name.

sdc.daemon.RouteName.title: RouteName
sdc.daemon.RouteName.description: The name of a model route the daemon declares (a table [routes.<name>] of its runbook.toml): one to 64 characters of letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`. A client names a route by it, never by an address, a token or an alias; the address, the token file and the prices stay in the daemon's file.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
